privacy_hero_desc: This page outlines Haddher platform's commitments to protecting teachers' data, lesson prep content, and full compliance with the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) in Saudi Arabia.
privacy_share_text: Privacy Policy & Data Protection - Haddher Platform: https://hader.sa/privacy
privacy_ask_extra_desc: Our support team is available to help and answer all your inquiries.
privacy_sec1_subtitle: Our full commitment to protecting teachers' data privacy according to approved laws.
privacy_sec1_p1: Welcome to Haddher platform, the smart assistant for teachers in Saudi Arabia. We recognize the importance of privacy and confidentiality of your educational and personal data, and are committed to protecting it according to the highest international standards and local regulations, notably the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).
privacy_sec1_p2: This Privacy Policy applies to all services and solutions provided through our website, web application, and the (Haddher) browser extension. By using the platform, you agree to the data collection and usage practices described in this policy.
privacy_sec1_highlight: Our goal is to provide a smart, secure, and reliable educational environment supporting teachers in fulfilling their noble mission without any concern regarding data safety or privacy.
privacy_sec2_subtitle: Details of personal, educational, and technical data that may be collected during service use.
privacy_sec2_intro: We strictly adhere to the "data minimization" principle, requesting only essential data necessary to deliver lesson planning services efficiently:
privacy_sec2_card1_desc: Full name, email, phone number, and subject/grade details for account creation and experience customization.
privacy_sec2_card2_desc: Lesson titles, behavioral objectives, teaching strategies, worksheets, and enrichment activities you create or save.
privacy_sec2_card3_desc: Authorized temporary session token to sync schedules and lessons with Madrasati without storing passwords.
privacy_sec2_card4_desc: Browser type, IP address, device type, and crash logs to improve platform performance and speed.
privacy_sec3_subtitle: How AI is used for content generation without compromising your data privacy.
privacy_sec3_intro: Haddher relies on advanced AI algorithms to assist teachers in generating lesson plans, activities, and interactive questions. We emphasize the following principles:
privacy_sec3_check1: Input data is used exclusively to generate and format the response for your current lesson.
privacy_sec3_check2: General AI models are never re-trained on your private account content or personal information.
privacy_sec3_check3: Processing occurs through encrypted, secure channels with certified cloud computing providers meeting top security standards.
privacy_sec4_subtitle: How the Haddher browser extension works and handles Madrasati sessions.
privacy_sec4_intro: The Chrome Extension allows teachers to sync class schedules and transfer completed lesson plans to Madrasati with a single click.
privacy_sec4_bullet1: No password storage: The extension never asks for or stores your Madrasati or Microsoft passwords.
privacy_sec4_bullet2: Temporary sessions: Only your active browser session token is used while you prepare lessons.
privacy_sec4_bullet3: Limited permissions: The extension never accesses pages outside of Madrasati and Haddher.
privacy_sec4_bullet4: Full control: You can disable or remove the extension at any time from browser settings easily.
privacy_sec5_subtitle: Encryption and cyber protection standards used to store your data on encrypted servers.
privacy_sec5_intro: We apply advanced technical and administrative measures to safeguard your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction:
privacy_sec5_card1_desc: Highly secure TLS 1.3 protocols for all communications.
privacy_sec5_card2_desc: Servers encrypted using the advanced AES-256 standard.
privacy_sec5_card3_desc: Continuous vulnerability scanning and regular automated backups to ensure service continuity.
privacy_sec6_toc: 6. No Data Selling or Third-Party Sharing
privacy_sec6_title: 6. No Data Selling or Third-Party Sharing
privacy_sec6_subtitle: Absolute commitment to never monetize or leak user data under any circumstances.
privacy_sec6_alert_desc: We state clearly and categorically: We never sell, rent, or trade your personal data or educational content to advertising companies or third parties for commercial gain.
privacy_sec6_p1: Limited data sharing may only occur with core infrastructure cloud providers (such as database hosting and AI compute) solely for running the service, subject to strict confidentiality agreements under the law.
privacy_sec7_subtitle: Rights to access, edit, export data, or permanently delete your account.
privacy_sec7_intro: Under personal data protection regulations, you as a teacher and user have the right to:
privacy_sec7_item1: The right to request and view a copy of your data stored with us.
privacy_sec7_item2: Edit or update any inaccurate personal information from the control dashboard.
privacy_sec7_item3: Request permanent deletion of the account, all personal data, and related lesson content.
privacy_sec8_subtitle: Use of cookies and local storage to save your preferences and active session.
privacy_sec8_intro: We use cookies and local storage solely for technical and operational purposes:
privacy_sec8_item1: Maintaining login session security and convenience.
privacy_sec8_item2: Saving appearance preferences (such as dark or light theme).
privacy_sec8_item3: Enhancing response speed and browsing experience across platform pages.
privacy_sec9_subtitle: How you are notified of updates and ways to reach tech support.
privacy_sec9_p1: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect service improvements or regulatory changes. In case of material changes, we will notify you via email or a prominent platform notice.
privacy_sec9_box_desc: Our Data Protection and Support team at Haddher is pleased to provide any clarification or assistance regarding data security.
